content:
maya: Quick pulse — quarterly OKR milestone check. Pls drop one-line: what shipped this sprint, what slipped, owner, and any CR pings. Need a short summary for the exec sync at 4pm.

devin: Shipped -> routing policy canary + autoscale tuning. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4213. Waiting on final CR from taylor. Perf looks good in canary. :rocket:

taylor: Will review PR today, aim EOD. Noted a small KV-cache edge case in perf tests that could affect tail latency — filing a comment.

sree: Slipped -> private deploy packaging (KMS integration). Staging tests failing with HSM auth errors. Owner: sree. Root cause investigation in progress, might need rollback.

katie: On infra side, creating INF-213 for the KMS/HSM auth failures. I can allocate 2 hours tomorrow morning to triage. If we need rollback, I can help validate the rollback job. :+1:

maya: TL;DR for exec: shipped: routing canary; slipped: private deploy packaging (KMS). Action items: @devin finish CR, @taylor validate KV-cache fix, @sree propose rollback plan by 10am PST tomorrow, @katie own infra triage.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout finished in us-west-2. Metrics: p50=12ms p95=42ms error-rate=0.1% (down). No deploy alerts.

devin: Also a heads-up: autoscale config change required a minor config key rename in prod, doc updated in the runbook: https://confluence.redwood/infra/autoscale-runbook. I'll add an entry to the migration checklist.

taylor: Quick note on CRs: I left two inline nits in the PR, both trivial. After those are addressed I'll give +1. @maya if you want a demo I can post a short recording.

sree: If infra can't unblock by 10am PST, I'll open rollback PR (draft) tonight and post link here. I want to avoid drift in private packages.

katie: Sharing staging logs snippet:
```
2024-04-11T22:12:03Z ERROR kms-client: auth failed code=403 token=expired
stack: kms.init -> signer.fetch -> hsm.auth
```
Will follow up in INF-213 with next steps.

maya: Ok. For the exec bullet points I'll say: 1) Routing canary successful, ready to promote after CR; 2) Packaging for Private is blocked by KMS auth — infra ticket opened, contingency rollback draft pending. Owners & ETA listed in thread. Anyone else with blockers?

devin: No other blockers. I'll ping when PR merged.

taylor: LGTM after tiny fixes, will ping here when done.

sree: I'll post rollback PR link or confirm fix timeline by 09:45 PST tomorrow.

maya: Thanks all — I'll assemble the 2-line exec update and post to the 4pm sync. :white_check_mark:
